resources.string: %1$s needs Notification Access to see and control what\'s playing in Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video, Spotify, YouTube Music, Amazon Music or YouTube: whether it\'s playing or paused, where you are, and the title and artwork the app shows in its media controls. That\'s how it keeps everyone in your watch party or jam in sync, and how a jam starts the same song or video on everyone\'s phone. For the apps you choose to share, it also shows your friends what you\'re watching or listening to.\n\nAndroid only gives this ability to apps with Notification Access. %1$s never reads your notifications, messages or their content, and never records your screen, video or audio.
